coupons_values_check.name: coupons_values_check
coupons_values_check.value: "coupons"."discount_value" >= 0 and ("coupons"."min_order_value" is null or "coupons"."min_order_value" >= 0) and "coupons"."used_count" >= 0 and ("coupons"."max_uses" is null or "coupons"."max_uses" >= 0) and ("coupons"."max_uses_per_user" is null or "coupons"."max_uses_per_user" >= 0)

custom_order_requests_budget_check.name: custom_order_requests_budget_check
custom_order_requests_budget_check.value: ("custom_order_requests"."budget_min" is null or "custom_order_requests"."budget_min" >= 0) and ("custom_order_requests"."budget_max" is null or "custom_order_requests"."budget_max" >= 0)

custom_order_requests_size_check.name: custom_order_requests_size_check
custom_order_requests_size_check.value: ("custom_order_requests"."size_eu" is null or "custom_order_requests"."size_eu" between 20 and 60) and "custom_order_requests"."pairs" between 1 and 50

orders_amounts_check.name: orders_amounts_check
orders_amounts_check.value: "orders"."subtotal_amount" >= 0 and "orders"."tax_amount" >= 0 and "orders"."shipping_amount" >= 0 and "orders"."discount_amount" >= 0 and "orders"."total_amount" >= 0 and "orders"."balance_due" >= 0 and "orders"."balance_due" <= "orders"."total_amount"

product_variants_stock_check.name: product_variants_stock_check
product_variants_stock_check.value: (not "product_variants"."track_inventory" or "product_variants"."stock_quantity" is not null) and ("product_variants"."stock_quantity" is null or "product_variants"."stock_quantity" >= 0)
